skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced macroeconomic models and theories to analyze and evaluate macroeconomic issues and policies in developing countries.
Analyze and evaluate macroeconomic policies in the context of developing economies.
Work independently and in groups, with skills in presentation and critical thinking to solve practical problems.
Enhance the ability to critically analyze macroeconomic issues and policies.
Use a range of tools from basic to advanced to conduct research and analysis on macroeconomic issues and policies in developing countries.
Conduct independent research and organize group activities to complete assigned tasks.
Develop skills in presenting research findings and engaging in group discussions.
Demonstrate self-reliance in independent work and responsibility in group activities.
